summary: Implementation plan for Craft Royale, a 3D Minecraft x Fortnite style battle royale game built with Three.js. Features 10-player battle royale matches, over-the-shoulder third-person combat with crosshairs, instant grid-building mechanics (walls, ramps, floors), fully destructible voxel environments and resource harvesting (wood, stone, metal), dynamic shrinking storm circle, 9 AI combat bots, procedural Web Audio sound synthesis, and an atmospheric low-occlusion HUD.
